question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c9d52205610f923e1e91b9920dcb4c09ca0ead56ef220130741de93e664bcf.png] **Logic : (Position value of first letter + Position value of second letter) = 2 (Position value of third letter + Position value of fourth letter)** So, • NHDB
